app.title: BarreFree
app.tagline: Turn any song into barre-free acoustic guitar chords.

input.title: Paste chords
input.placeholder: Paste a chord sheet here: chords over lyrics, or ChordPro with inline [C] chords.

hint.original: Chords as written, barre shapes included.
hint.capo: Best capo position; the chords themselves never change.
hint.easy: Capo plus the nearest open chord for any remaining barre (F → Fmaj7, Bm → Bm7).
hint.beginner: Easy, plus simpler chords and as few different shapes as possible.

capo.label: Capo position
capo.infeasible: No capo position can play every chord in this mode.

sheet.title: Chords
sheet.label: Chord sheet
sheet.capoNote: Put the capo on fret {{capo}}. Chord names are the shapes you play.
sheet.capoNoteSounding: Put the capo on fret {{capo}}. Chord names are what you hear; the diagrams show the shapes to play.

diagrams.title: Shapes
diagrams.label: Chord diagram for {{chord}}: {{frets}} (low E to high E)

upload.title: Analyze a recording
upload.hint: MP3, WAV, FLAC, Ogg or M4A, up to {{mb}} MB. You can also drop a file here.
upload.unavailable: Audio analysis needs the BarreFree server, which cannot be reached right now. Pasting chords still works.
upload.notReady: The BarreFree server is running but cannot analyze songs yet: its chord recognizer is still being installed or did not load. Pasting chords still works.

error.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
error.tooLong: The file or the song is too long for this server.
error.notAudio: This does not look like an audio file.
error.tooShort: The recording is too short to analyze (under a second).
error.rate: Too many uploads. Wait a minute and try again.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
error.generic: The upload failed. Please try again.

recognizers.chordino: Chordino (chroma + HMM, best on our tests)

upload.separateHint: Removes vocals and drums before listening for chords. Helps when a loud voice or drums confuse the result; takes about as long as the song itself.
upload.transcribe: Also write out the notes (tab, experimental)
upload.transcribeHint: Transcribes the single notes too, for a tab of a finger-picked part. Works best on a clean guitar recording.

job.title: Analyzing
job.working: Listening to the song. This takes about a minute.
job.saving: Saving the song to your library…
job.expired: This analysis is no longer on the server. Upload the song again.
job.saveFailed: The analysis is done, but the song could not be saved on this device.
job.storageFull: This browser's storage is full. Delete songs you no longer need from the library, then try again.

song.missing: This song is not in your library on this device.
song.noAudio: The audio of this song is missing.
song.strumHint: D = down, U = up, - = skip the stroke. A starting point only: listen to the song for its rhythm.

player.label: Player
player.loopTooShort: Move at least half a second away from A, then set B.

chart.title: Chords
chart.label: Chord chart, one column per beat
chart.editHint: Tap a chord to correct it. Your fixes are saved on this device.
chart.uncertainCount_one: {{count}} chord is uncertain (marked with a dotted outline). Listen and fix it if needed.
chart.uncertainCount_other: {{count}} chords are uncertain (marked with a dotted outline). Listen and fix them if needed.

edit.title: Fix this chord
edit.label: Chord
edit.placeholder: e.g. Am7, F/C, N for no chord
edit.invalid: This is not a chord name the app understands.
edit.frame: Type it the way this chart writes chords (with the capo and transposition shown).

library.title: Library
library.hint: Songs you analyzed, kept in this browser (also offline). Nothing is stored on the server.
library.unavailable: This browser does not let the app store songs (site data may be blocked or the window may be private). Allow site data for this site to keep a library.

link.title: Analyze a song from a link
link.notice: Paste a Spotify track or a YouTube video link. Spotify only gives the title and artist; the audio comes from a YouTube video you choose. Downloading from YouTube may be against its terms of service, so use this only for songs you have the right to use, and at your own responsibility.
link.label: Link
link.searched: Videos found for “{{query}}”: pick the right one

error.unsupported: This is not a Spotify track or YouTube video link.
error.failed: The link could not be looked up right now. Try again later.
error.none: No videos were found for this track.

tab.title: Tab (experimental)
tab.notice: Written out by a model from the recording, in open position (frets 0–5 above the capo, no barre). Check it by ear: transcription misses and adds notes, especially with singing or drums.
tab.capo: Capo on fret {{capo}}: frets count from the capo.
tab.unplayable_one: {{count}} note is out of reach in open position and left out.
tab.unplayable_other: {{count}} notes are out of reach in open position and left out.
tab.empty: No notes to show in open position.
tab.renderFailed: The tab could not be drawn. Copy or download it instead.
